title: Roof Repair in Portland, OR
summary: In July 2026, French Roofing repaired a shingle roof on a home in Portland, OR. On a lower roof beside a wall and downspout, the cracked and torn shingles came out and new shingles were patched in, tied into the rows around them. The new shingles are lighter than the weathered roof around them, so the repair is easy to spot in the photos.

faqs.question: Was the whole roof replaced on this Portland job?
faqs.answer: No. This was a repair: the damaged shingles beside the wall and downspout came out and new shingles were patched into the existing roof.
